summary: FINDING-1 is rejected because audited repository evidence supports the compatibility requirement. FINDING-2 is approved as a citation-supported, material, repository- and implementation-independent readiness failure.

verdicts.reason: The alleged unsupported invention is contradicted by repository evidence: Session._collectfile applies pytest_ignore_collect (repository:F4), and an existing regression test verifies collect_ignore prevents traversal/import of an ignored package tree (repository:F9). Preserving this established behavior is a repository-specific compatibility constraint, not a citation-supported material readiness failure; hindsight validation also includes ignore coverage.

The cited acceptance check requires the undefined “full relevant collection test suite” to pass while the contract supplies no command, path, test list, or selection rule. That leaves a material completion boundary to implementer judgment despite implementation_ready being true. The defect is assessable from the contract alone, does not depend on any implementation choice, and is not negated by hindsight evidence showing one particular selected suite.
